'''October 2001 Buford tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG pre-release held in Buford, GA on 27 October 2001. It is known from Damian Loback's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3078">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-28-buford-ga-10-28-01d3078/ buford-ga-10-28-01], DeckTech (Damian "Jamintheeye" Loback, 28 October 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-28-buford-ga-10-28-01d3078/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 27 October 2001
* '''Site:''' Buford, GA
* '''Format:''' [[Reflections Booster Draft]]
